titleEn: Royal decree No. 176 on revocation of Snoul Wildlife Sanctuary in Kratie province and Roneam Daun Sam Wildlife Sanctuary in Battambang province

articles.en: The Snoul Wildlife Sanctuary, with a total area of 75,000 hectares, is hereby revoked from the Royal Decree dated 01 November 1993 which established the protected areas.

The Roneam Daun Sam Wildlife Sanctuary, with a total area of 39,961 hectares, is hereby revoked from the Royal Decree dated 29 September 2003 which revised the area of the Roneam Daun Sam wildlife sanctuary.
Any provisions contrary to this Royal Decree shall be considered null and void.

Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen, Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Cambodia, shall be responsible for implementing this Royal Decree from the date of signature onwards.
